title: Recordings
subtitle: Privileged session recording — every administrative action on a recorded surface is captured as a hash-chained frame, anchored to the evidence ledger.

badge.gapHint: Frames were reserved but never written — the recording has a permanent, evident gap.
badge.breakglassHint: Opened under a break-glass grant — always recorded.

empty.title: No recording sessions yet
empty.description: When operators act on a recorded privileged surface, their sessions appear here.

notice.strip: This is a recorded privileged surface — actions are captured to the evidence ledger.

consent.title: Recording notice (AC-8)
consent.body: Privileged actions on this control plane are recorded: each administrative request is captured as a hash-chained frame anchored to the evidence ledger — route shape, identifiers and a one-way body digest only, never payloads or secrets. Break-glass sessions are always recorded. Continuing requires acknowledging this notice.

policy.title: Recording policy
policy.subtitle: What is recorded on this control plane, and how the evidence is classified. Editing requires the recording:config:admin permission; every change here is itself a recorded privileged action.

forbidden.title: Editing the recording policy requires recording:config:admin
forbidden.description: Your role can administer recording sessions, but changing the recording policy needs the distinct recording:config:admin permission. Ask an administrator to grant it.

error.title: Could not load the recording policy
error.description: The recording policy could not be read. Retry, or check that the module is mounted.

breakglass.label: Break-glass sessions
breakglass.hint: Emergency break-glass access is always recorded — no policy can turn it off. The recording floor is permission-based, not namespace-based.

namespaces.label: Recorded namespaces
namespaces.hint: The module surfaces whose privileged actions are captured. Each must name a mounted module; an unknown name is rejected by the server.
namespaces.empty: No namespaces recorded — privileged actions are not captured on any module surface.
namespaces.shape: A namespace is lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter and not ending in - or _.
namespaces.duplicate: That namespace is already in the list.
namespaces.tooLong: A namespace is at most {{max}} characters.
namespaces.tooMany: At most {{max}} namespaces can be recorded.

consent.label: Require acknowledgement before privileged actions
consent.hint: Deny-closed ("required"): operators must acknowledge the AC-8 recording notice before acting. Off leaves the notice as a banner only ("notice").

idle.label: Idle-seal timeout (seconds)
idle.hint: An open recording session is sealed after this much inactivity. Between 60 and 86400 seconds.
idle.error: Enter a whole number of seconds between 60 and 86400.

retention.label: Retention class (days)
retention.hint: A classification tag applied to sealed recordings — it labels how long they should be kept. Between 1 and 3650 days.
retention.notEnforced: Retention is a classification tag only — recordings are labelled, never purged. No policy removes a recording yet (no purge is wired).
retention.error: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 3650.

ai.label: AI-derived summaries
ai.hint: Allow generating model-derived session summaries. A summary is a derived narrative, never evidence — the hash-chained frames remain the record.
